generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The bidder shall furnish Form of Bid as per Annexure-III of bid document.
Bidder shall possess Independent PF Registration Certificate issued by the Regional PF commissioner and copy of the same shall be furnished.
Bidder shall possess GST Registration certificate and the copy of same shall be furnished.
Bidder shall possess PAN card and copy of the same shall be furnished.
Bidder shall possess Independent ESI Registration Certificate and copy of the same shall be furnished.

The bidder shall not been subjected to forfeiture of EMD / terminated / foreclosed on account of our default in regard to the execution of work in KPCL or Government or any other utility or shall not have been blacklisted at the time of submission of bid for participating in tender by KPCL or Government or any other utility in India at the time of submission of bid. The bidder shall furnish a self-declaration for not forfeiture of EMD or foreclosure or termination of their Contract as per Annexure-IV of bid document.
The bidder shall furnish registration of establishment / firm / company / individual from govt. Authority / Dept. of labour.

The Bidder shall furnish self declaration that the employees working under him at KPCL site shall not claim for employment in KPCL at any point of time, if the contract is awarded as per Annexure-V of bid document.

Class-I or above Electrical License issued by Electrical Inspectorate, GOK. If the electrical license is issued by other state governments, bidder should get electrical license from electrical inspectorate of GOK within 2 months from the date of issue of work order. A declaration to this effect shall be furnished.
Declaration by the bidder for conforming to contract terms & conditions as per Annexure-VI of bid document.
Undertaking by Contractor as per Annexure-VII of bid document.
Declaration by the bidder on Medical Fitness Certificates for Workmen as per Annexure-VIII of bid document.
Declaration by the bidder on Safety Practices and Accident Reporting as per Annexure-IX of bid document.
The bidder should be free from any of the statutory body appraisal/ obligation/charges undergoing & shall produce relevant proof / declaration with an undertaking to get absolved.

The bidder should be a regular Agency/Contractor/Firm with Class-I or above Electrical License issued by Electrical Inspectorate & should have satisfactorily completed the work in the field of Routine/Breakdown maintenance of 415V or above electrical switchgear/system in any Generating Stations /Utilities/ various PSUs of State/Central Govt./Private owned Firms as a Prime Contractor. In proof of the above, copies of Work order and Work Done certificate for at least one single work order with an executed value not less than Rs.62.77/- Lakhs (excluding GST) issued by competent authority in the preceding five years i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26 shall be furnished. Cost of work executed in previous years shall be given 10% of weightage per year to bring them to the financial year, in which the tenders are invited.
